caption: What a table file can say

rows.does: A list on the table. It changes the room, the lines and the head of the whole table.
The table scrolls inside its frame. Use it with the variant sticky.
One more row at the end, for a sum.
On a column. It says what the cells hold. A number stands at the end of its cell.
On a column. The text stays on one line, or it breaks inside a long word.
On a column. The column is as narrow as its text, or it takes about half of the table.
